say:1:1033445001:1.text: I totally agree with you, but it's kind of embarrassing; all we've got at the camp is equipment like leaf armors and machetes.
say:1:1033445001:1.source_cn: 准备更多物资自然是稳妥的——但不好意思地说，营地中储备...

say:2:1033445002:1.text: I wish we had more to offer, but these rattan boxes and ropes are what we could put together for now. I hope they find them useful nonetheless...
say:2:1033445002:1.source_cn: 临时只能凑出一些藤条箱和绳索，不知道能不能帮上忙，希望...
